QuestInfo.name: In Search of a Piglet
QuestInfo.0: You decide to search for the piglet so Evan can go to Turtle Island. \r\nYou should ask Utah for leads.
QuestInfo.1: That piglet couldn't have gotten far. Check the farm entrance.\r\n#rIf you fail to complete the quest, you must forfeit it and speak with Utah to start it again.#k
QuestInfo.2: Find the piglet for Evan, who's gone to Turtle Island

0.0: Didja say you're going to find that piglet for us? It shouldn't have gone far. Why don't you check at the #bFarm Entrance#k?

yes.0: Just head toward Henesys and you'll get to the #bFarm Entrance#k sooner or later. Try not to get lost.

no.0: I thought you said you'd help! Evan's already gone, too.

1.0: You got my piglet back! Thanks much.

yes.0: Hey, little piglet, how many times must Evan bring his dragon home before you realize she's NOT going to eat you? Sigh.

item.0: Just head toward Henesys and you'll get to the #bFarm Entrance#k sooner or later. Try not to get lost.
